data.one_liner: Easy-to-use URL-based router for Flutter web, mobile and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Wraps over Flutter's Router API to provide simple declarative mapping from URLs to pages. Supports nested navigation for tabs, route guards, redirects, and multiple route maps.
use_when: You need a declarative, URL-based router for mobile, web, and desktop
You want easy support for tab-based nested navigation
You need to handle route guards or swap entire routing maps based on auth state
avoid_when: You prefer a strictly imperative navigation approach using Navigator.push directly without URL mapping
strengths: Simple declarative API with path and query parameters support
Built-in tab and nested route handling
Extensive unit, widget, and integration test coverage
weaknesses: Requires learning a specific path-based routing structure
data.setup_notes: Configure MaterialApp.router with RoutemasterDelegate and RoutemasterParser.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the officially supported declarative routing package by the Flutter team.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer code-generation for strongly-typed route arguments and auto-generated navigation code.
